greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siqukile ngenxa yokuba asizange sithembe ngokupheleleyo. Nkosi, yiba nenceba. Kristu, siqukile ngenxa yokuba siye sayeka uloyiko lwalawula iintliziyo zethu. Kristu, yiba nenceba. Nkosi, siqukile ngenxa yokuba siye sayeka ukubona ukukhanya kwakho ebumnyameni. Nkosi, yiba nenceba.
psalm_response: Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla!
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana, umfana osakhulayo, ehleli phantsi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu, ejonge phezulu ngamehlo agcwele ukumangaliswa. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo hlobo lwembono. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe ngoncumo olungazenzisiyo, owayebona ihlabathi njengendawo ebanzi, ezele ngamathuba okufunda nokwakha. KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane usimema ukuba sijonge phezulu, kodwa hayi nje esibhakabhakeni esiluhlaza, kodwa kwisango elivulekileyo lasezulwini. 'Ndiye ndabona umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini,' utsho uYohane. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Umnyango ovulekileyo. Asiludonga oluvaliweyo, asiluphelo lwendlela, kodwa sisimemo sokungena kwi-Banquet yasezulwini apho uBen ngoku aphumla khona.

KwiVangeli, uYesu usixelela umzekeliso wamakhoboka awanikwa iitalente. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Isicaka esinye sagcina imali yaso emhlabeni ngenxa yokoyika. 'Ndiyoyika, kuba ungumntu onzima,' sitsho isicaka. Le yinyaniso enzima: uloyiko luyakwazi ukubopha intliziyo yethu, luyakwazi ukusenza sifihle iitalente zethu, luyakwazi ukusenza sikholelwe ukuba uThixo unzima okanye akasiboni. Kodwa uYesu usifundisa enye into. Ufuna ukuba sisebenzise oko sinako, sisebenzise uthando lwethu, sisebenzise ubukrelekrele bethu, sisebenzise ubomi bethu—naxa buvakala bufutshane—ukwakha ubukumkani bakhe.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo evulekileyo ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndikwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lukaThixo olugqithise ukuqonda konke. Hamba ngokuthula kukaKristu.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakwintlungu, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini, ndaza ndeva ilizwi elinjengesandi sexilongo elalithethileyo kum ngaphambili, lisithi, “Nyuka uze apha, ndikubonise okwenzeka emva koku.” Ngoko nangoko ndakhwankqiswa nguMoya. Kwakukho itrone ezulwini, kwaye lowo wayehleli etroneni wayenokubonakala okufana ne-jasper ne-carnelian. Ngeenxa zonke etroneni kwakukho isaphetha-mvula esikhazimla njenge-emerald. Ngeenxa zonke etroneni ndabona ezinye iitrone ezingamashumi amabini anesine, apho kwakuhlala abadala abangamashumi amabini anesine, benxibe iingubo ezimhlophe benemiqhele yegolide ezintloko zabo. Etroneni kwakuphuma imibane, ukuduma, nezandi zendudumo. Izikhuni ezisixhenxe ezivuthayo zazivutha phambi kwetrone, ezo zingoomoya abasixhenxe bakaThixo. Phambi kwetrone kwakukho into efana nolwandle lweglasi olunjengekristale. Phakathi nangaphambili kwetrone, kwakukho izidalwa ezine ezinamehlo ngaphambili nangasemva. Isidalwa sokuqala sasifana nengonyama, esesibini sasifana nethole, esesithathu sasinebuso obunjengobomntu, kwaye esesine sasifana nokhozi olubhabhayo. Izidalwa ezine, ngasinye sithwele amaphiko amathandathu, sasigcwele amehlo ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imini nobusuku aziphumli ukumemeza: “Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi Thixo onamandla, owayekho, okhoyo, noza kubakho.” Ngalo lonke ixesha izidalwa eziphilayo zinika uzuko nembeko nokubulela kulowo uhleli etroneni, ophilayo ngonaphakade kanaphakade, abadala abangamashumi amabini anesine bawa phantsi phambi kwalowo uhleli etroneni, bamkhonze ophilayo ngonaphakade kanaphakade. Baphosa imiqhele yabo phambi kwetrone, besithi: “Ufanele wena, Nkosi Thixo wethu, ukwamkela uzuko nembeko namandla, kuba wena wadala zonke izinto; ngenxa yentando yakho zafika zaba khona, zaza zadalwa.”

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Dumisani iNkosi endaweni yayo engcwele, yidumise esibhakabhakeni samandla ayo. Dumisani ngenxa yezenzo zayo ezinamandla, yidumise ngenxa yobungangamsha bayo. R. Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Yidumise ngesandi sexilongo, yidumise ngomrhubhe nangohadi. Yidumise ngesigubu nangomdaniso, yidumise ngemitya nangemibhobho. R. Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla! Yidumise ngamacangci avakalayo, yidumise ngamacangci akhonkothayo. Konke okuphefumlayo makayidumise iNkosi! Alleluia. R. Oyingcwele, oyingcwele, oyingcwele Nkosi, Thixo onamandla!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngeli lixa abantu bephulaphule uYesu ethetha, waqhubeka ebalisa umzekeliso kuba wayekufuphi neYerusalem kwaye babecinga ukuba uBukumkani bukaThixo buza kuvela khona kwangoko. Ngoko wathi, “Indoda ebalulekileyo yahamba yaya kwilizwe elikude ukuze izifumanele ubukumkani ize ibuye. Yabiza amakhoboka ayo alishumi yanika ngalinye imali yegolide, yathi, ‘Rhwebeni ngale mali ndide ndibuye.’ Kodwa abemi belo lizwe babeyithiyile, bathumela abathunywa emva kwayo ukuba bathi, ‘Asifuni le ndoda ibe ngukumkani wethu.’ Kodwa xa yabuya emva kokufumana ubukumkani, yabiza amakhoboka eyayiwaphe imali, ukuze yazi ukuba yenze ntoni ngorhwebo. Owokuqala weza phambili wathi, ‘Nkosi, imali yakho yegolide yenze ezinye ezilishumi.’ Yathi kuye, ‘Wenze kakuhle, khoboka elilungileyo! Uthembekile kule nto incinane; phatha izixeko ezilishumi.’ Emva koko elesibini leza lazisa, ‘Imali yakho yegolide, nkosi, yenze ezinye ezintlanu.’ Nalo khoboka yathi kulo, ‘Wena, phatha izixeko ezintlanu.’ Emva koko elinye khoboka leza lathi, ‘Nkosi, nayi imali yakho yegolide; ndiyigcine kwilaphu, kuba bendikoyika, kuba ungumntu onzima; uthatha oko ungakubekanga, uvune oko ungakuhlalanga.’ Yathi kulo, ‘Ngalamazwi akho ndiza kukugweba, khoboka elingendawo. Ubusazi ukuba ndingumntu onzima, ndithatha oko ndingakubekanga, ndivune oko ndingakuhlalanga; kutheni ungayifakanga imali yam ebhankini? Ngoko xa ndibuya ndingayiqokelela nenzala.’ Yathi kwabo babemi kufutshane, ‘Thathani imali yegolide kulo, niyinike elo khoboka linemali elishumi.’ Kodwa bathi kuyo, ‘Nkosi, linemali elishumi.’ Yathi, ‘Ndithi kuni, wonke umntu onayo, uya kongezwa, kodwa lowo ungenayo, noko anako uya kuthathwa. Ngoku ke, malunga nezo ntshaba zam ezingafuniyo ukuba ndibe ngukumkani wazo, ziziseni apha nizibulale phambi kwam.’” Emva kokuba etshilo, waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe esiya eYerusalem.

day: Wednesday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
